sourceRoot: .github/source-agents for role, central strategy and governance agents; module .github/agents for migrated module registry agents and module-local live role entries, including TriCompany module-local registry agents
targetRoot: multi-root .github/agents with TriMetaverse/.github/agents reserved for central entries and TriCompany/.github/agents valid for TriCompany module live entries
notes: 2026-05-22 起，TriMetaverse/.github/agents 下所有可发现 live agent 必须有 TriCompany 源侧发布来源。
人格岗位 agent 来源于 TriCompany/.github/source-agents/<employee-id>/。
central strategy 和 governance agent 来源于 TriCompany/.github/source-agents/registries/；已迁移模块 registry agent 来源于各模块 .github/agents/，TriCompany 模块 registry 也同样来源于 TriCompany/.github/agents/。
模块级 registry agent 的目标形态是迁回对应模块 .github/agents；迁移时必须先合并中央口径，再移除 TriMetaverse/.github/agents 下同名 discoverable 文件，避免多 root 同名双活。

2026-05-22 起，Triavatar、Tristaciss、TriMC、Tride、Tripilot、Trideployment、TriTest、TriLC、TriWeb4、TriChain、TriMobile、TriMem、TriDev、vscodium、TriCompany registry 三件套已迁为对应模块 .github/agents 下的模块侧 canonical live entry。
2026-05-22 起，ChiefHumanResourcesOfficer、ChiefAdministrativeOfficer 与 RAndDTrainer 已完成当前 Copilot-host live 启用；CHO/CAO 位于 TriMetaverse 中央 live discovery，RAndDTrainer 位于 TriCompany 模块 live discovery。
源侧未发布或未完成 live binding 的岗位、监督类 agent 不得留在 TriMetaverse/.github/agents 被发现。
旧 phase-1 tricompany 平行文件名回迁路径不再作为当前发布路径；历史基线仍保留在 TriCompany-copilot-host-assets 的 phase evidence 与 archive 中。

liveDiscoveryPolicy.companyGovernanceRegistry: governs publishing discipline, CHO/CAO boundary, and agent discovery eligibility
liveDiscoveryPolicy.businessStrategy: governs central commercial boundaries and module priority
liveDiscoveryPolicy.registryHierarchy: module Product/Code registries obey module BusinessStrategyRegistry; module registries fan in to TriMetaverse BusinessStrategy/Product/Code registries; governance findings remain separate under CompanyGovernanceRegistry

preflightChecks: TriCompany/.github/source-agents is source-side publish input only; TriCompany/.github/agents may exist as module live discovery, but must not contain source-agent five-piece drafts
TriMetaverse/.github/agents contains no unpublished role or oversight agents; CHO and CAO must have source kit, support object, binding profile and manifest alignment before remaining discoverable
RAndDTrainer is discoverable from TriCompany/.github/agents and must retain source kit under TriCompany/.github/source-agents/rd-trainer

Each formal module has BusinessStrategyRegistry, ProductRegistry and CodeRegistry live entries with exactly one discoverable target; migrated module registry agents live in the corresponding module .github/agents and must not remain duplicated in TriMetaverse/.github/agents
CHO and CAO are not conflated in source docs or live discovery policy
